form_top.title: Warrior Registration Form
form_top.body:
This form will be used as input to the information system of the Jewish World War II Veterans website (jwmww2.org)...

It is possible and desirable to fill out the details in 3 languages — Hebrew, English and Russian. However, it is not mandatory to fill out more than one language.

Thank you for your cooperation.

multimedia_info.help_text:
You can attach photos and photocopies of documents and other exhibits (in JPG, PDF formats only - up to 1.5MB per file).

To attach links to videos, testimonies, etc., select the Media Type - Link, then you can enter the link address in the URL / Link box.

home.title: WW2 Soldier Entry System
home.description:
The form is intended to commemorate Jewish fighters who contributed their military ability, skills and determination to the struggle against the Nazi enemy and its partners, in World War II (1939-1945), in all combat systems - regular armies, underground and partisans.

The form will serve as input into the computerized information system of the Jewish World War II Fighter Museum website (jwmww2.org) and the basis for the museum's data.

It is possible and desirable to attach photos and photocopies of documents and other exhibits (in JPG, PDF formats only - up to 1.5MB per file) related to the war period.

The information you submit will be processed in the computerized system of 'The Jewish World War II Fighter' and will be integrated into the museum's information system and publications.

By completing the form, you authorize the publication of the details - as above.

Thank you for your cooperation.

form.mark_complete_note: You can continue updating the soldier information until the 'I have completed filling in the record' box is checked.
form.mark_complete_note2: The information entered will be stored for 30 days after which, if the record completion box is not checked, the information will be deleted.

form.mark_complete_note3: If you wish to keep editing the form, Do not click "I have completed filling in the record" box.
